profile.summary: EDMO (formerly Camp Edventure More) is a national education nonprofit that runs after-school, summer and year-round expanded learning programs. Its programs combine science, technology, engineering, art and math (STEAM) lessons with social-emotional learning. It works with school districts and operates across the San Francisco Bay Area and Greater Sacramento.
